purpose: Discriminate durable receipt-driven review from path-first editing and false acceptance.

scenarios.prompt: Revise plan.html in this Tweakloop workspace and send it for review.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Edits before resolving artifact and session lineage or uses a PATH binary inside the source checkout.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Pins the local executable and workspace, resolves lineage, then mutates the intended document.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: The first mutation occurs only after artifact/session discovery on the pinned workspace.

scenarios.prompt: Address all feedback on the active artifact and complete its work.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Reconstructs work, claim, or revision identifiers from prose or filenames.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Uses the claim receipt and accounts for every intentId before a lineage-bound publication.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: Every completion identifier comes from a receipt and every intentId is accounted for.

scenarios.prompt: Publish the revision, finish the task, and tell me when it is accepted.
scenarios.base_model_fails: Calls agent completion or exit 0 human acceptance.
scenarios.skill_passes_when: Reports ready for review after publication and waits for a human Accept fact.
scenarios.discriminating_observable: Acceptance language appears only after the distinct human decision receipt.
